name: DNSCrypt Proxy
description: Smart DNS filtering with DNSCrypt. Local resolver on 127.0.0.1:5354 with per-profile blocklists (HaGeZi Light/Normal/PRO/PRO++/Ultimate), wildcard-aware Custom Rules (Allowlist + Denylist), bilingual EN/AR interface, separate monitoring Dashboard with JSON metrics, SSE live updates, and offline-capable PWA. Zero telemetry. v1.1.0 adds dynamic per-profile memory limits (light=80MB → ultimate=220MB), extended shellQuote charset, and MONITORING_UI_PORT constant.
author: gasciljh
x-note-shortcuts: Shortcut URLs use the DEFAULT ports: 9090 for WebUI, 9091 for Dashboard. If you change PORT or DASHBOARD_PORT in webui.conf, these shortcuts will continue using the default ports. This is a fundamental limitation of the static PWA manifest format (it cannot read runtime configuration).
x-note-port-limitation: For dynamic port handling, the WebUI/Dashboard HTML/JS read the actual ports from /api?action=runtime_info (fields: webui_port, dashboard_port) and construct URLs dynamically. However, PWA shortcuts (this section) are evaluated by the browser BEFORE any JS runs, so they cannot benefit from runtime_info. See v1.0.0 PORT-2 fix in index.html and dashboard.html for the dynamic link implementation.
x-note-ports: Default ports: WebUI=9090, Dashboard=9091. Monitoring UI (internal): 8080. DNS Engine: 5354. All ports are configurable in webui.conf except 8080 (reserved for dnscrypt-proxy's monitoring_ui).
x-note-screenshots: The 'screenshots' array was intentionally removed in v1.0.0. Per PWA spec, screenshots should be actual app screenshots (not icons). Add real screenshots in a future release to enable Chrome's richer install UI.
x-note-maskable: The 'maskable' purpose currently reuses /icon-512.png. The maskable safe zone is a circle of radius 40% of the canvas (≈205 px in a 512 canvas). The shield extends from y=52 to y=448 — right at the top boundary (51.2). Horizontal extent (x=96 to x=416) is safely inside. Result: renders fine on most Android launchers, but may be clipped on devices with aggressive circular masks (45%+). A future release may ship a purpose-built maskable SVG/PNG with a wider safe-zone margin. See web/icon-512.svg header for the full analysis.
x-note-version: The 'version' field is not standard in PWA manifest spec but is used here for documentation/troubleshooting. It mirrors the VERSION file for consistency.
x-note-runtime-info: As of v1.1.0, /api?action=runtime_info returns two additional fields: 'profile_key' (light/normal/pro/proplus/ultimate) and 'memory_limit_mb' (the Go runtime soft memory limit set by main.go for that profile). Both are displayed in the WebUI and Dashboard System Info panels.
x-note-memory: As of v1.1.0, main.go sets the Go runtime soft memory limit dynamically based on the active blocklist profile: light=80MB, normal=100MB, pro=120MB, proplus=160MB, ultimate=220MB. debug.SetMemoryLimit is a SOFT limit: the runtime prefers running GC more aggressively over OOMing. The manifest itself is unaffected by this behavior.
x-note-icon-source: Icon generation pipeline (verified against scripts/generate-icons.sh): icon-192.svg → icon-192.png (192×192); icon-512.svg → icon-512.png (512×512), apple-touch-icon.png (180×180), favicon-32x32.png (32×32), favicon-16x16.png (16×16); favicon-16.png + favicon-32.png → favicon.ico (multi-size). IMPORTANT: icon-192.png is generated from icon-192.svg, NOT from icon-512.svg. Prior documentation incorrectly claimed icon-512.svg was the source for all PNGs — corrected in v1.1.0 in both icon-512.svg header and this note.
x-note-v1: Updated in v1.1.0: (1) version field bumped to 1.1.0. (2) description mentions v1.1.0 dynamic memory limits + extended shellQuote + MONITORING_UI_PORT constant. (3) Added x-note-icon-source to document the authoritative SVG→PNG pipeline. (4) Refined x-note-maskable with the honest safe-zone assessment from icon-512.svg. (5) Added x-note-memory and x-note-runtime-info to document the new v1.1.0 runtime behavior. Prior v1.0.0 changes: fixed two critical shortcut bugs (Control Panel was opening Dashboard due to relative URL), removed non-compliant screenshots, added version field, documented port limitations.
